description:
Hushfeed v0.71.1 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 1.15.1.

A small one on top of 0.71.0 from earlier today. With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption now stays at the height TikTok showed it instead of dropping to the bottom edge (#141). And with Show a LIVE under the status bar on, the strip under the clock is shaded like the rest of the room's top (#137).

Since 0.71.0 went out without a list like this, here's every report the two releases changed something for, and what changed.

Fixed in 0.71.1

* Captions dropping to the bottom in Clear display (#141). The kept caption now sits where TikTok drew it before the controls went away.
* The strip under the clock not matching the LIVE (#137). With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, it's shaded like the rest of the top now.

Fixed in 0.71.0

* Progress bar on videos not showing (#134). It's back on For You, short videos included.
* Videos added to collections won't play (#135). Tapping a saved video plays that video again, and the feed filters leave lists you open alone.
* Animated stickers stuck in comments (#130). They move again. The switch behind it is now called Don't decode animated frames ahead.
* Creator name cut short next to the country (#127). The whole name shows when the row has room for both.
* Double tap for comments sometimes opened the share panel too (#63). A second tap held a moment too long no longer brings up the long press menu.
* Black status bar coming back in LIVE rooms (#137). It stays away for the whole LIVE. There's also a new Show a LIVE under the status bar switch.
* The small share sheet losing Report and Download (#120). Hide the Send to row hides only that row now.
* Puzzle pieces in LIVEs (#87). Protect external pages counts the CAPTCHA puzzle as one of TikTok's own pages, so it keeps its link back to TikTok.
* Passkeys (#102). A new Skip passkey sign-in patch lets TikTok offer your password or a code instead.
* TikTok's language resetting after a reboot (#61). The new Keep the app language patch keeps the language you picked in TikTok.
* The music disc not spinning (#68). Spin the music disc is new under Feed screen, along with Keep the music disc still.
* The button at the top left (#128). Hide feed LIVE button still patches on a build where that button can't be found.
* Progress bar over the creator's name on opened videos (#50). It sits under the caption again.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). Lots here. It clears videos opened from search or a link, the thin line and the loading bar go away with it, Fade the video controls works with it, and back or share no longer turn it off.

Added in 0.71.0 for requests

* Double tap and long press (#136). Double tap can do anything Long press does, and Long press can like the video.
* LIVE quality (#57). Offer LIVE quality in more rooms adds the picker to most rooms that didn't have one.
* Downloading stories (#93). Turn on Save a story from its share sheet under Downloads.
* A seek bar on stories (#72), and an always visible seek bar with a bigger handle and the time (#90). Both got new switches under Playback.
* Keep playing in the background (#99). Replay in the background starts a video over when it ends.
* A comment translate button (#85), and languages left untranslated (#121), where zh-TW and the other Traditional Chinese codes now keep Traditional Chinese.

Added to help track down

* The seek bar preview picture (#140). With Log diagnostics on, the log says how many preview pictures each video came with.
* TikTok's storage use (#70). The diagnostic report lists the biggest folders.
* Joining a LIVE by voice (#132) and the create tab closing (#133). Remove LIVE extras and Remove creation tools now say what they take out, so you can leave them out if you use those.

## What's changed

* With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption in Clear display now sits where TikTok showed it before the controls went away, instead of dropping to the bottom edge (#141). Before any caption has shown, it keeps the old spot.
* With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, the strip under the clock is shaded like the rest of the room's top again. On phones where TikTok keeps a black strip for the bar, it showed lighter than the stream below it (#137).

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* 3874 runtime tests and 765 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 132 patches applied to TikTok 47.1.4 with desktop CLI 1.18.1. Resource checks passed, and the attached release receipt records the exact bundle and its result.
* This bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 on a Galaxy S22. With Keep captions in Clear display on, the caption in Clear display sat at the same height TikTok showed it before the controls went away (#141).
